articles.t: For A Game Known For Stealing Cars, GTA 6's Transit System Is Actually Useable And Unbelievably On Time - Jalopnik
articles.chapeau: Public transit that actually works and arrives on time is the least believable part of GTA 6.
articles.txt:
Sonny Evans via YouTube Add Jalopnik on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Ok, Jalopnik admittedly went really hard on enlightening you on everything from immediate upgrades to behind-the-scenes secrets related to "Grand Theft Auto VI" last week. Maybe a little too hard. I promise this one-off discovery was purely out of genuine interest and transportation nerdiness. It's all about Leonida's public transit system.
YouTuber Sonny Evans is not a page I've ever come across in my gaming watches until today, and from what I've seen on his page, he tends to look into the beyond of game play, or simply someone who the wild what-ifs in open world games. The best way to understand his vibes is reading his bio which said: "I walked a bowl of stew across the map in Red Dead Redemption 2 and millions of people actually watched it." My guy. His more recent posted videos include driving a mobility scooter across the entirety of Leonida in GTA 6, following NPCs to see where they go and what they do, and the latest: seeing if GTA 6's public transportation actually works .
Sonny inspected the game's public transit ventures, using the in-game maps to navigate from home base to Vice City using the Interstate Loop buses and the metro lines before landing at Vice City airport. He timed the transit moves, mentioning at about 3:28 in the 10-minute video that his commute into Vice City via the Loop bus was 5 hours of game time. This absolutely correlates with the idea that Leonida is a Florida-like state, likely size-wise as well.
Sonny Evans via YouTube Sonny did the same with Vice City's Metro system, using the in-game posted maps and timing boards to see if the trains really did run on time. They did! This unfortunately makes them a little unrealistic, because anyone who has ever taken any form of public transit knows that nothing will be on time. Ever.
He also found a real, tiny discrepancy. The signs at the stop showing the Northbound and Southbound routes (showing the stops like they do on the New York City subways) for the trains were identical, which actually makes no sense. This made it a little more challenging for Sonny to figure out which way to go. Luckily, he guessed right and continued on to Vice City's airport.
This is where the video went a little off of the rails. Sonny discovers a few hidden areas including the underneath room to the luggage carousels. Then there was the speed run of getting past TSA, causing a little chaos, and ended with Sonny (as Jason, the main character) stealing a commercial plane.
So, it looks like if you get stranded somewhere in Leonidas and have no car handy to steal or carjack, you might be able to depend on public transit. The care the creators took in making that entire system work, even if its on-time buses and trains are somewhat unrealistic, is mad impressive. Now to see if someone will do their entire gameplay using just the public transit. I can't be the only person who would watch that.

articles.t: How to Do the Advanced Tracker Removal Glitch in GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Learn how to do the Advanced Tracker Removal glitch in GTA 6 and deliver cars to Randy without triggering a police chase.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google Players have discovered a new glitch in Grand Theft Auto VI that lets you steal rare cars without setting off their Advanced Trackers. The trick makes completing Randy’s Wishlist a lot easier, since you can drive to the drop-off without a police chase. Here’s how to do the Advanced Tracker Removal glitch in GTA 6 .
The Advanced Tracker Removal glitch in GTA 6 works by having Jason drive the stolen car while Lucia leads him to Randy in a separate vehicle. As long as Jason is the one driving the stolen car, its Advanced Tracker won’t go off as he follows you.
To make the exploit work, you will need the Key Cloner app and a second vehicle for Lucia to drive. If you’re using your personal vehicle, call it over with Scooter Bros before you start so it’s ready when you need it.
Find the exotic car you want to steal for Randy’s Wishlist, then use the Key Cloner app on your phone to break into it.
Have both Jason and Lucia get into the stolen car, but don’t hit the gas pedal. Hold Right on the D-pad and select “Wait In” to tell Jason to stay in the car.
Now that Jason is waiting in the stolen vehicle, have Lucia get out and hop into her own car. If you called it over with Scooter Bros, it should already be nearby.
Once Lucia is in the second vehicle, hold Right on the D-pad again and select “Follow Me.” Jason will now drive the stolen car behind you without triggering its Advanced Tracker.
Drive to Randy’s in Lucia’s vehicle. Jason will follow you in the stolen car, so you can take your time getting to the drop-off without the tracker alerting the police.
Wait for Jason to arrive behind you at Randy’s. Once he pulls up, hop into the stolen car and deliver it. The best part? Because Jason is driving the vehicle, it will arrive with zero damage. In my game I got $30k for the delivery as I triggered a “perfect bonus.”
Yes, you can use the glitch before Randy unlocks Advanced Tracker Removal. To unlock the regular service, complete “Photo/Shoot” in Chapter 4 , deliver the Declasse Mamba GT , and wait for Randy’s follow-up call. That service removes the tracker when you register or sell the car at a Pay ’n’ Spray.
The glitch is more useful as it lets you get a Wishlist car to Randy without setting off its tracker on the way. It pretty much allows you to steal any rare or exotic car in the game, without having to worry about police tracking you down again.
If you’re looking for another trick, check out our GTA 6 money glitch guide to see how to earn unlimited cash in seconds.

articles.t: GTA 6 Is A Tragedy Because You Cannot Sit Down And Eat Spaghetti
articles.chapeau: I was bummed about the food selection in GTA 6 until I understood what it was saying about Jason and Lucia
articles.txt:
Everyone, including me, has been making much (rightfully) of how incredible the level of detail in GTA VI is. This game is ridiculous, man! The sheer amount of incidental and specific dialogue, the clothing, the way characters move, the weather, the TV and radio programs, I could go on all day. But there’s a single aspect I’ve found where the level of detail genuinely felt short of what I’d hoped for going in: the food.
You cannot sit down and enjoy a slow, relaxing meal. There is nowhere to order a plate of spaghetti or other food to be eaten explicitly there, in the establishment. There is no cooking. There is only fast food and takeout. And that’s how I know this game is going to be a tragedy.
I love video game food. I love cooking through video game cookbooks, I love beautifully designed and rendered meals within game worlds, and I love creative food crafting systems. So I’m always on the lookout for such things! And in one respect, I actually think GTA VI does food beautifully. It is freaking incredible that you can hold a food and a drink (or two foods, or two drinks) in each hand simultaneously, and swap between consuming each of them at will. Last night, I took Lucia out to a food truck and bought an empanada and a mojito. I had her stand there and take bites of the empanada, and watched with wonder as the empanada disappeared, bite by bite in her hand. (I tried to take a sip of the mojito but accidentally pulled my gun instead and someone called the cops, but I’m sure it would have been equally impressive).
Much has been made of this system, and deservedly. Jason takes bites of apples , and the apples having those bites visible in them until only the core is left! The pair will drink liquids, and you can see the liquids in the containers slowly recede! All of these items have unique models, too: burgers, tacos, croissants, the grilled fish sandwiches made in an early mission that have different levels of char as Jason cooks them… God, it’s incredible! Hats off!
I don’t want anything about that system to change. I love being able to eat handheld foods like this. But what bothers me is that this is…all that Jason and Lucia ever eat.
I complained about this earlier , after a glimpse in the pair’s fridge in an early trailer. Mostly alcohol and protein shakes. Nothing substantial whatsoever to keep two active crime-doers properly fed. But at the time, I thought that was just…their state at that moment in the game. I assumed eventually the pair would end up in a situation where they ate food like normal human beings.
Yet this never happens. I’m in chapter 3, and I’ve consulted with our reviewer who has finished the game, and my understanding is that the pair will never evolve beyond eating on the go. You can’t order a plate of spaghetti or some lo mein and sit comfortably and lazily consume it. The pair never cooks food at home, either as a mechanic or even as a visual suggestion, as their cabinets remain full of nothing but plain bread and cereal and unused pots and pans right up until the end of the game. Every restaurant that looks like it could be a proper sit-down dining establishment is closed and locked to you, and everything that’s open serves like, five things: water, soda, beer, and roughly two handheld food items. And those same 10-20 food items are repeated ad nauesum across all the game’s restaurants, regardless of what’s on the posted menu. In a small handful of establishments, you can sit down to eat those items, but it still doesn’t look like the two are relaxing over a meal. Again, I understood this early in the game—the two were broke, Jason was living a bachelor life, and they were on the run. Hell, the motel room in Chapter 2 doesn’t even have its own coffee pot. I get it.
But as the two move to Vice City, build wealth, and start living at a higher standard, I really just thought there’d be some option, somewhere, for one of them to take the other out on a nice dinner date. Maybe just a little cutscene showing a decent plate of food with the two all dolled up. Or perhaps, if that was too risky, the barest suggestion that either of them had ever cooked at home: TV trays, or a dirty pot in the sink, or more than like four spices sitting in the window for some reason. Even like, a discussion about having eaten a meal?
So on one level, I’m disappointed. I love seeing gorgeous food renders in games, and I can only imagine Rockstar’s would be stellar . I think a lot about how the Dragon’s Dogma team

articles.t: 'The Results Are Very, Very Impressive' - Digital Foundry Praises GTA 6 On Xbox One | Pure Xbox
articles.chapeau: "﻿Latency is also exceptional - at least in context."
articles.txt:
The smartypants over at Digital Foundry are still putting in the work, this time going deep into the nitty gritty of how well GTA 6 performs when streamed through the Xbox Cloud Gaming app on Xbox One.
Following their rigorous testing on Xbox Series X and Series S, PS5 and PS5 Pro, the boffin boys have now spent a good week putting streamed performance, latency and image quality under the cosh.
Xbox Cloud Gaming is streamed from Microsoft servers which means the version of GTA 6 you'll be playing is the Xbox Series S version. Of course, this means the drawbacks present on the Series S version are also present in the Xbox Cloud streamed one.
"Let's start with nuts and bolts of the experience. As with other Xbox Cloud Gaming titles, which are streamed from Microsoft servers rather than your own console, the version of GTA 6 you're getting here is the Xbox Series S version. That means a few things just by the nature of the Series S port itself - slightly ropey performance, quality setting cutbacks across the board and a 720p base image upscaled to 1080p using FSR 4.1. However, you do at least get all of the game's major effects intact, including ray-traced lighting, ray-traced reflections and strand-based hair."
Performance begins where you'd expect on Xbox Series S, clocking around 20-30FPS. However, Digital Foundry notes that "frame pacing is significantly worse than the real deal, with quicker 16.7ms frames and slower 50.0ms frames surrounding the expected 33.3ms ones."
From their Xbox One Cloud tests, they used an ethernet connection, and were genuinely impressed with GTA 6's image quality. They mentioned the game isn't "significantly degraded by the streaming process", with little visible compression or artefacting when in motion. Stood still, it's hardly noticeable too.
Streaming GTA 6 at 1440p (via Xbox Game Pass Ultimate on One S or X) also appears to benefit from a higher bitrate than usual, with DF stating it gets a "higher bitrate than that afforded to other games". For context, GTA 6 streamed at about 37mbps, compared to the recently released Control: Resonant , which only got 15-27mbps.
Latency also looks to be the big winner in testing. Digital Foundry tested GTA 6 running natively on Xbox Series S with the streamed version on Xbox One, finding the latter only added a mere 9ms to latency. Barely noticeable.
"Latency is also exceptional - at least in context. We measured around an extra 9ms of added latency compared to running GTA 6 locally on Series S - 184.5ms vs 175.2ms -which is essentially imperceptible for a game that is running on all consoles with around 160 to 180ms of latency anyway . That makes the pace relatively sedate, even when driving or shooting, but it's something that you can get used to over time, and the cloud version doesn't change the equation here. These numbers come from a console attached via ethernet cable to a high-speed fibre connection with a wired controller; your mileage may vary based on location, internet speed, controller latency, display latency and so on."
So, GTA 6 looks decent and feels comparably responsive controller in hand, with the biggest drawback to streaming the game on Xbox One being that it pulls from an Xbox Series S version, and not the Series X version of the game.
Of course, if you can't access current-gen hardware, Digital Foundry thinks streaming GTA 6 through the Xbox Cloud app on Xbox One is a pretty good way to experience the universally acclaimed RPG. But that generally comes with Cloud Playtime charges , including if you go beyond your monthly allotted hours on Xbox Game Pass.
Have you tried Xbox Cloud streaming GTA VI? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below.

articles.txt:
Hot GTA VI : 31,4 % de l'attention mondiale en une semaine Pendant sa semaine de lancement, GTA VI a capté 31,4 % de toute l'attention mesurée pour les jeux vidéo, et la part cumulée des jeux live-service est tombée de 57 % à 42,4 %.
Suis-nous sur Google (nouvel onglet) Partager Garder pour plus tard Gardé pour plus tard Grand Theft Auto VI 492 230 sur Twitch Crédit : Rockstar Games GTA VI a réuni 31,4 % de toute l'attention mesurée pour les jeux vidéo pendant sa semaine de lancement. C'est près de trois fois le record de Fortnite en 2019 et environ dix fois le score d'une grosse sortie typique. Les chiffres viennent de Screen Engine/ASI, qui a suivi plus de 8 500 jeux dans le monde sur Google, YouTube et Twitch.
Le jeu de Rockstar a presque triplé le précédent record hebdomadaire d'attention. Depuis le début du suivi en 2019, il est le quatrième jeu à atteindre la première place mondiale, aux côtés de Minecraft, Roblox et Fortnite.
Le lancement a laissé des traces chez la concurrence. La part d'attention cumulée des jeux live-service (ces jeux multijoueurs qui reçoivent des mises à jour régulières) est passée de 57 % à 42,4 % d'une semaine à l'autre, soit une baisse de plus d'un quart. C'est la première fois que ce chiffre passe sous les 50 % depuis que Screen Engine/ASI suit le marché en 2019.
Les éditeurs revoient leurs dates. Octobre a connu le plus faible nombre de sorties recensées par Screen Engine/ASI depuis sept ans, et le premier trimestre 2027 devrait avoir le calendrier le plus calme depuis 2021, les éditeurs adaptant leurs lancements autour de GTA VI.
Le mode en ligne, GTA VI Online, n'est pas encore sorti et sa date de lancement reste inconnue.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' chapter 1 is so good that I'm afraid to move on to chapter 2
articles.chapeau: Please help me.
articles.txt:
I've run into a very stupid problem with Grand Theft Auto VI , a game I love so far.
Namely, I'm having a surprisingly difficult time moving on from chapter 1 of the game's sprawling crime story. For a couple of real-life days now, I've been sitting on the edge of finishing GTA 6 's opening stanza with very little motivation to move on. At the time of writing, I have literally one story mission left to go before the first chapter ends, and almost nothing of substance left to do otherwise.
But as much as I know I need to break through and see the rest of what GTA 6 has to offer, it's hard to resist the call to just live out Jason Duval's mundane daily routine for eternity.
Warning: There are some light spoilers for early parts of GTA 6's story in the following section.
For those who haven't played GTA 6 yet or are still in the early stages like me, chapter 1 follows Jason's meager existence as a sort of paid goon for Brian, a local boatyard owner who dabbles in drug trafficking on the side. The other protagonist, Lucia, gets out of prison partway through the chapter, but for most of it, she's not playable yet. Most of the story and side missions in chapter 1 focus on Jason doing little odd jobs that occasionally spiral into chaotic violence. He spends time with his girlfriend or buddies and otherwise just kind of chills when he's not doing all the crime stuff.
GTA 6 chapter 1 immediately establishes an endearingly ordinary routine for Jason, at least by action video game protagonist standards. Every in-game day I wake up, feed the pet snake, drink coffee, work out, drink a protein shake, and take a shower before heading out to do whatever it takes to get enough money to set up a nest egg for Jason and Lucia.
While there are some minor gameplay incentives to doing all of that, GTA 6 doesn't outright demand any of it from the player. I'm just doing it because it's a legitimately interesting loop, especially by the standards of big-budget mainstream games. I'm not just endlessly traversing between icons on a map and shooting some bad guys when I get to each one. I feel like an active participant in the everyday lives of two adults, which at the very least is novel for this type of game. It also helps that Brian is voiced by Stephen Root, so you spend most of chapter 1 being yelled at by Buck Strickland , and that's lovely.
I mean, most of my favorite missions so far have barely involved crime at all. The one where Jason and Lucia go to a bar after she gets out of prison is a remarkable virtual rendition of a romantic night out, while I've already lavished the Carly Rae Jepsen mission with praise on this website.
All of that is why I'm having such a hard time moving forward with the main story. I know in my heart that chapter 2 will likely introduce a new setting with new stakes, new mechanics, and an increased focus on crime. And all of that will probably be fantastic in its own right, but it won't be the same as the game I've loved up until now.
And if that's the feeling Rockstar intends to elicit in players when chapter 1 draws to a close, I would say they pulled it off. Maybe even a little too well. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content

Alex has spent most of the last decade reviewing games, smartphones, headphones, and laptops, and he doesn’t plan on stopping anytime soon. articles.t: GTA 6 : des moddeurs déverrouillent les 60 fps sur les PS5 jailbreakées
articles.chapeau: Un groupe de moddeurs a réussi à faire sauter la limite des 30 fps sur GTA 6 pour les joueurs munis d'une PS5 jailbreakée. Mais les conditions pour en profiter sont assez limitantes.
articles.txt:
Alexandre Schmid 26/11/2026 18:50 Partager Partager Copier Un groupe de moddeurs a réussi à faire sauter la limite des 30 fps sur GTA 6 pour les joueurs munis d’une PS5 jailbreakée. Mais les conditions pour en profiter sont assez limitantes.
Décidément, les joueurs ont décidé de s’approprier GTA 6. Rockstar Games vient à peine de faire arrêter un projet de portage PC de GTA 6 par décompilation que le studio se retrouve à devoir gérer un nouveau problème : un mod permettant théoriquement de faire tourner le jeu à 60 fps sur PS5 si la console est jailbreakée, alors que GTA 6 est normalement capé à 30 fps, même sur PS5 Pro .
En installant un certain patch sur sa PS5 ou PS5 Pro, GTA 6 n’est plus limité à 30 fps , mais à la moitié de la fréquence de rafraîchissement de la TV. Cela signifie que les propriétaires d’une TV 120 Hz peuvent atteindre les 60 fps en jeu. Si vous êtes équipé d’un écran ne dépassant pas les 60 Hz, rien ne change, vous ne pourrez pas monter au-delà des 30 fps.
“Ce patch est plus un déverrouilleur de FPS qu’un patch 60 FPS, donc modérez vos attentes. Les utilisateurs de PS5 Pro auront la meilleure expérience” , explique l’un des auteurs. Ce qu’il faut bien comprendre ici est que le fichier ne permet pas de jouer à GTA 6 de manière fluide à 60 fps, mais seulement de débloquer la possibilité de monter jusqu’à 60 fps lorsque techniquement possible.
Les limitations du GPU, et surtout du CPU des PS5 et PS5 Pro, s’appliquent encore. Face à l’exigence demandée par le titre, les consoles souffrent. La PS5 peut même tomber autour des 20 fps lors de la conduite et des scènes d’explosion. Il est même probable que la future PS6 ne vise pas les 60 fps stables pour GTA 6 , c’est dire.
En principe, il n’y a pas de risque à long terme pour la console, qui s’éteindra automatiquement en cas de début de surchauffe. Mais nous n’irions pas jusqu’à recommander la manipulation, alors que GTA 6 faisait planter les PS5 à la sortie . Promis, nos premières impressions sur GTA 6 ont été recueillies suite à des sessions de jeu sur une PS5 non jailbreakée.

articles.t: Sorry Jason And Lucia, These 5 GTA 6 Side Characters Steal Every Scene They're In
articles.chapeau: Jason and Lucia aren’t GTA 6's only great characters, as these 5 have really endeared themselves to Polygon’s writers
articles.txt:
Although Jason and Lucia are the stars of Grand Theft Auto 6 and amazing characters in their own right, there are lots of side characters who steal the show whenever they show up. From folks critical to the main story path to weirdos you meet if you take the time to stop and chat with someone on the side of the road, GTA 6 constantly introduces wild, memorable characters almost every hour.
These side characters make the world of GTA 6 feel more fleshed out, lived in, and representative of all different kinds of kooky folk. They’re a big part of what makes the game special, and we’re thankful that Rockstar Games took the time to make us care about people other than Jason and Lucia. In particular, these five characters emerged as some of the Polygon staff’s favorites.
Image: Rockstar Games Brian is the single biggest scene-stealer in GTA 6 for one reason: Stephen freakin’ Root ! For years, Root has been one of Hollywood’s ultimate “Hey, it's that guy” character actors. Now, fresh off an extremely well-deserved Emmy win for his role in Widow’s Bay , he brings the same kinetic, frenetic energy to Brian in GTA 6.
The eternal brilliance of Root’s acting comes from the humanity he injects into every character — often people who would be impossible to believe in lesser hands. Like many of Root’s best roles, Brian is a little too wacky for the real world, but there is a clear and nuanced sense of humanity underneath all of that eccentricity. That ethos is reflected throughout the entirety of Grand Theft Auto, and Brian is the key to selling it from the start. —Ari Notis
Of all the side characters Rockstar has introduced in GTA 6 , Raul Bautista (voiced by Manny Pérez) is my personal favorite. He commands attention — not through loud bravado, but through quiet, seasoned authority. Raul carries himself around with a sun-bleached cool reminiscent of Don Johnson’s Sonny Crockett mixed with the criminal smarts of Robert De Niro’s Nick Wells from The Score . Raul isn’t the sort of guy who needs to announce himself or make a show of what he can do. As a seasoned bank heister who knows Vice City like the back of his hand, Raul operates with understated confidence and stays deliberately out of the spotlight, treating high-stakes scores like a craft rather than a spectacle.
Living on a boat also shows he’s calculated down to his quarters and can pull anchor and disappear on a dime whenever the heat closes in. What makes him especially intriguing is how little we know about his past. Who knows? He could’ve easily crossed paths with Michael Townley and Trevor Philips during their early heisting days — and maybe even learned a thing or two from them. — Ryan Epps
Image: Rockstar Games Midway through GTA 6 , just as the heists are heating up, Jason becomes an accidental hip-hop mogul. In a series of missions, Jason is called upon to help promote Real Dimez, an up-and-coming rap duo managed by Only Raw Records. articles.t: 'GTA 6': How to get more than $15,000 early on with almost no effort
articles.chapeau: No killing required.
articles.txt:
Everyone's journey through Grand Theft Auto VI is going to go a little differently, as that's the nature of a big, freeform open-world adventure. But one thing is certain for every player: You're going to need money, and fast.
That's especially true at the beginning of chapter 2 of the game's main story. For reasons I won't spoil in case you aren't there yet, chapter 2 finds Jason and Lucia in a tough spot with almost no money to their names, and an urgent need to get some. Thankfully, there are a couple of different methods that, when combined, can net you somewhere between $15,000 and $20,000, with almost no killing or even any real effort required.
Just understand that there may be some minor spoilers for the beginning of chapter 2 if you decide to read ahead.
We'll start with a method to get at least $10,000 (and possibly as much as $14,000), which we first learned about from GamingBible and tested ourselves to ensure it worked. Without beating around the bush, it does work.
It involves going to an abandoned warehouse outside the town of Hamlet, which is easily accessible from the very beginning of the game. However, because ( spoiler warning ) you lose all of your held money at the end of chapter 1, I highly advise waiting until chapter 2 to do this.
Anyway, you'll know you're in the right place if you follow the waypoint marker in the screenshot above and see a warehouse with an Apollo sign out front. There will be lots of vehicles and construction equipment outside, but don't worry, it's totally empty inside. Well, except for a bunch of rotting corpses and more than $10,000 worth of contraband lying around. Simply pick all of it up, stash it in the trunk of your car, and take it to a fence for a low-effort, no-risk payday.
Just make sure you have a fence available to you when you do this. You'll unlock one early in chapter 2, so perhaps you should work your way through a few main story missions at the beginning of the chapter before taking this on. It's also logistically a little easier to do this with both Jason and Lucia together, as there is a lot to carry in there, so maybe keep playing until that's an option, too.
This second batch of cash is one we heard about from our friends at IGN , and, again, we can vouch for it ourselves. It's something you can only do after the start of chapter 2, but just to reiterate, you are pretty destitute with almost no money and no vehicles to your name at that point in the game. It's worth playing a couple of story missions to at least fix the vehicle problem first before doing this next bit of money-stealing.
To be specific, there is a "rainy day fund" of $5,000 cash hidden in Jason's bedroom in his old house. Unfortunately, by this point in the game, that house has been exploded real good, and the entire neighborhood is a heat area where cops are stationed and looking for Jason and Lucia. It's a bit of a hike from where the story takes place in chapter 2, and it's in a risky spot, so this is a super easy wad of cash to miss.
Still, you can at least drive (or take a cab) down to the area outside the heat zone and go on foot from there. Do whatever you can to sneak to the backside of Jason's house and get inside. You can easily evade the cops if you stick to nearby backyards and maybe do a little bit of swimming. Just stay crouched and quiet, and you'll get in and out easily. Once you're in, go to Jason's old bedroom, open the stash, and grab the $5,000. You can also optionally grab some old photos while you're at it, which will raise Jason and Lucia's relationship rating.
If you do both of these things, which should take maybe half an hour of real-time at most, you can roll around in chapter 2 with as much as $19,000 in your account before you get started doing real crimes. Have fun, folks.

articles.t: Despite No Disc, GTA 6 Recorded the UK
articles.chapeau: People love plastic boxes
articles.txt:
GTA 6 has been breaking records all over the place, so it doesn't come as much of a surprise to learn that its performance at physical retail has been mighty impressive.
As reported by The Game Business , based on data from UK tracker Nielsen IQ, GTA 6 has recorded the country's largest physical launch since 2019's FIFA 20 . Turns out only the nation's love of football can compete.
GTA 6's physical sales generated £32 million in revenue in its first three days. Apparently, it's the 17th biggest physical launch in the UK ever.
That might not sound particularly grand, but if you consider how much the physical market has shrunk over the last few years, it's actually pretty remarkable.
All this has transpired despite the game's physical copies coming with a download code rather than a disc, something that caused some anguish among collectors and enthusiasts.
I think it maybe proves that people will still show up for a physical product, even in a world where discs are on their way out.
PlayStation plans to discontinue making discs for its platform starting in 2028, but it's possible we'll still see physical launches for major games — just with a code in the box instead of a Blu-ray.
Anyway, GTA 6 has been selling well on all fronts, surprise surprise. Did you pick up the physical version of the game? Tell us in the comments section below.

articles.chapeau: Le Rockstar Game Workers Union, qui aurait été le plus important syndicat du jeu vidéo au Royaume-Uni, demandait la création d’« un cadre fo
articles.txt:
Les employés de Rockstar Games, l’éditeur de la saga GTA , ont rejeté la reconnaissance d’un syndicat interne, qui aurait été le plus important du secteur du jeu vidéo au Royaume-Uni selon l’Independent Workers’Union of Great Britain (IWGB), ont annoncé ce jeudi 26 novembre le syndicat et le studio.
Le scrutin de deux semaines portait sur un accord négocié depuis quatre mois entre la direction et les employés, visant à reconnaître le Rockstar Game Workers Union, branche de l’IWGB. Sur les plus de 1 500 salariés de l’éditeur de Grand Theft Auto VI appelés à voter, plus de 75 % se sont exprimés contre.
La proposition rejetée jeudi aurait créé « un cadre formel » permettant aux employés du studio de négocier collectivement leurs conditions de travail avec la direction, notamment les salaires, la compensation des heures supplémentaires, les primes, les congés et les retraites, a détaillé le syndicat. Ce dernier pourra cependant continuer de se réunir et de recruter de nouveaux membres.
« Nous reconnaissons malheureusement que nous avons encore du travail à faire pour renforcer la compréhension et gagner la confiance d’un plus grand nombre de nos collègues », a indiqué le Rockstar Game Workers Union dans un communiqué. « Ce résultat reflète le fort soutien de notre équipe en faveur de la poursuite des relations directes, de la collaboration et du dialogue ouvert » chez Rockstar, a pour sa part commenté la responsable de l’édition du studio, Jennifer Kolbe.
L’IWGB représente actuellement plusieurs anciens salariés devant le tribunal du travail de Glasgow, en Écosse , région berceau de la franchise. Il accuse Rockstar de les avoir licenciés en octobre 2025 en raison de leur activité syndicale.
Le géant du jeu vidéo affirme que les plaignants avaient partagé des informations confidentielles, y compris sur le dernier volet de GTA, sur des canaux de discussion non sécurisés de la plateforme Discord .
Avec plus de 39 millions de joueurs uniques qui ont lancé le jeu sur PS5 en quelques jours après sa sortie il y a une semaine, le sixième opus de la saga GTA a marqué « le plus grand lancement de l’histoire de PlayStation », d’après Sony .

articles.t: Rockstar UK staff reject union recognition by three to one after GTA 6 launch - Startup Fortune
articles.chapeau: Rockstar
articles.txt:
If you're facing a union drive, a lopsided ballot can settle whether you have to bargain. It can't settle what a judge makes of the way you treated people before anyone voted.
Three in every four Rockstar Games employees who voted in the UK have turned down formal recognition for their union. The result announced on Thursday, November 26, was 75.3% against and 24.7% in favor of a deal with the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB), on a turnout of 93.2%. The count was 1,163 ballots against and 381 for.
More than 1,600 staff were eligible, nearly everyone below director level, The Register reported, at sites that include Edinburgh, Dundee, Leeds, Lincoln and London. The count landed a week after Grand Theft Auto 6 went on sale, a debut that Take-Two, Rockstar's parent, estimated brought in $3.79 billion on its first day.
Without recognition, Rockstar has no obligation to bargain collectively with the IWGB or sit down with it regularly. The agreement staff rejected had taken four months to negotiate and would have covered pay, bonuses, overtime, pensions and leave, along with consultation on HR policies and AI, according to The Register. People were voting on a deal that already existed on paper.
About 6% of Todoist users had email addresses and old SHA-1 password hashes downloaded on November 23, the company says. Smaller groups had API or Slack tokens taken, or saw task text and Outlook email previews exposed, so your next step depends on your notice. - what to do after Todoist data breach - Todoist hacker searched tasks for API keys
Jennifer Kolbe, Rockstar's head of publishing, had told Bloomberg before the ballot opened: "We go where the team goes. So if they want a union, they will have a union." After the count, she said the result "reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong."
The IWGB admitted it fell short. "Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues," it said. Organizers aren't leaving, and their branch says it still represents workers at the company and will double down.
Look at the sequence. The union asked for voluntary recognition on June 30 and talks began in July. Rockstar then sent an agreed package to a secret online ballot while saying publicly that it would accept either answer. We don't know why individual employees voted the way they did, so don't treat this as a formula for winning. It did put the choice squarely with the workforce.
British law has also made life easier for unions. Under changes made by the Employment Rights Act 2025, a statutory recognition ballot held since April 6 needs only a simple majority of votes cast, and the old demand for support from 40% of the whole bargaining unit is gone. An application must still meet the applicable statutory membership threshold. Rockstar's margin would have defeated even the easier test, but you shouldn't assume yours will.
The unfinished business sits with Employment Judge Lucy Wiseman in Glasgow. Rockstar fired 34 people in the UK and Canada on October 30, 2025, including 31 UK-based union members, according to IBTimes UK. Twenty-three former employees brought claims that include dismissal for union activity and blacklisting, and closing arguments ended on November 18.
The two accounts are far apart. Rockstar says this was gross misconduct involving confidential company information shared on a Discord server. Its lawyer, Thomas Cordrey, told the tribunal the claimants were "caught red-handed," and the company's case is that the server had more than 300 people in it, among them former employees, competitors and a journalist. The claimants allege that a covert informant told management on October 7 that union membership was nearing 10%, with the sackings following soon after. They also say they got no details of the charges, no disciplinary hearing and no appeal, TechTimes reported. Rockstar denies any link to union activity.
An early round went the studio's way. In January, a judge refused the workers interim relief, which would have kept them on pay until trial, after finding they hadn't shown a high enough chance of proving union activity was the reason. articles.t: Top 10 Fastest Motorcycles In GTA 6—All Locations & How To Get Them
articles.chapeau: Here's the top 10 fastest motorcycles in Grand Theft Auto 6, as well as where you can find each one scattered across Leonida.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 features over 500 vehicles for you to get behind the wheel of, and whilst most of them are cars, there’s an incredible selection of motorcycles to pick from as well, and a ton of them know how to test the speed limits.
Whether you’re racing through the streets of Vice City or simply looking for the perfect getaway vehicle, speed is always going to come in handy. Thankfully, of the nearly 80 motorcycles in the game, a lot of them are incredibly high-performance, though finding them can be a bit tricky.
With that in mind, here are the 10 fastest motorcycles in GTA 6, as well as how you can get your hands on each one.
The fastest motorcycle in Grand Theft Auto 6 is the Principe Burnished Alvino.
This is one of the many Standout Vehicles in GTA 6, with the Principe Alvino being the base model of the motorcycle. But if you’re looking for speed on two wheels, you’ll find no better than the Principe Burnished Alvino.
The best part about this motorcycle, though, is that it’s pretty easy to get a hold of, with no Trackers to deal with or Key Cloners necessary to take control. Better yet, it’s pretty cheap to register, too! But where do you find it? Find out further below.
Of all the 77 motorcycles to be found in Grand Theft Auto 6, the ones listed below are the 10 fastest, strictly according to the in-game Speed stat.
And of these 10 vehicles, five of them are Standouts, meaning you’ll have to go hunting in specific locations if you want to get your hands on them—but more on that later.
For now, check out the complete table for the 10 fastest motorcycles in GTA 6:
It’s all well and good knowing what the 10 fastest motorcycles are in Grand Theft Auto 6, but the real question is: how do you get your hands on them for yourself?
Luckily for you, we have all of the answers. Below you’ll find the locations for all 10 of the motorcycles mentioned in the table above.
You’ll find the Principe Burnished Alvino parked on Starfish Island. Head to the exact location marked on the maps above, and it’ll be there tucked away in a garage on the property—just beware of the security on the island.
Getting a hold of Emilio’s Lectro is as easy as going to the location marked on the maps above and breaking into the garage. Since it’s on an open street, beware of becoming Wanted for trespassing, but the bike should make for a perfect getaway vehicle if you do.
If you’re looking to acquire a Nagasaki SFB 1000 and want to find one reliably, your best bet is to grab the Standout version of the motorcycle, which can be found below, since the vehicle has a chance of spawning in a variety of places across Leonida.
In order to get the Nagasaki KD’s SFB 1000, you’ll need to complete “Dre’Quan’s Gift,” a mission in GTA 6. This should become available partly through Chapter 3, sometime after the Photo/Shoot mission.
Getting hold of the Nagasaki Smokescreen Carbon RS will have to wait until Chapter 3, as you need the Cut-Off Tool in order to break into a Scoop container.
That said, if you have the equipment, head to the construction site marked on the map above, and use one of the nearby vehicles to move some concrete out of the way that’s blocking the entrance to the container. Inside, you’ll find the bike ready to go, and you’ll need it too, as there’s a chance you’ll be Wanted for trespassing.
As is often the case with base versions of vehicles, it’s difficult to find a guaranteed spawn location, but we had very good spawn rates in the location marked above. Lots of bikes spawn in and around here, so check back a few times and see if one manages to spawn—you might even find one of the other base vehicles on this list, too!
That said, you’re better off grabbing the Principe Burnished Alvino, the Standout version that’s also the fastest motorcycle in the game!

There’s no guaranteed spawn for the standard version of this vehicle, but the location marked above (the same as the Principe Alvino V1) proved particularly reliable during our testing. Several bikes can appear in this area, so keep an eye out and revisit if necessary.
That said, you’re better off grabbing the Nagasaki Hung Carbon, the Standout version found in the entry above.

articles.t: The staggering surge in physical video game sales following GTA 6 launch
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 alone accounted for £32 million of the physical sales during its launch week
articles.txt:
Want to bookmark your favourite articles and stories to read or reference later? Start your Independent Membership today.
New data has revealed physical video game sales skyrocketed by 409 per cent following the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , even though that format of the game doesn’t even come with a disc.
Boxed software revenues, covering discs and “code-in-a-box” (the format Rockstar chose for GTA 6), hit an estimated £43 million during launch week, according to figures compiled by NielsenIQ (NIQ). It was the strongest week for physical games in the UK since Christmas 2018 , when FIFA 19 was released.
GTA 6 alone accounted for £32 million of the physical sales during its launch week, NIQ said.
The firm added that its figures were estimates for the wider retail market based on shopping data.
The game was released on 19 November, ending a 13-year wait among fans worldwide for the next instalment of Rockstar 's video game series.
The standard version carried a price tag of around £69.99, while the more premium version cost around £89.99.
Buyers who want a physical copy get a box containing a code to download the game, rather than a disc.
Digital versions, by contrast, can be bought and downloaded onto gaming consoles straight away.
Dorian Bloch, senior client insight director at NIQ, said the sales performance for physical copies was “particularly impressive” against a market that is increasingly geared towards digital downloads.
“There have only been 16 games released since 1995 that generated higher boxed software revenue in their opening week,” he said.
“This demonstrates the enduring appeal and retail power of one of gaming’s biggest franchises.”
The release also sparked a wider resurgence in demand for gaming consoles, NIQ's data showed.
PlayStation 5 sales rose 46 per cent during launch week compared with the previous week.
Xbox Series console sales jumped by 75 per cent week-on-week.
Demand for other gaming accessories like headsets, joypads and chairs also soared, according to the figures.
Joost van Dreunen, an Adjunct Assistant Professor at NYU Stern School of Business who teaches the business of video games, said physical sales would be just the beginning for a game like GTA 6.
“ GTA V made $1bn in three days in 2013, which turned out to be the small part. GTA Online kept millions of people paying every month for thirteen years and became the real business. So we’d do well to judge GTA 6 accordingly: the launch is act one, the online world that follows is act two, and act two is where the money is.”
Although there is no official word on a release date for a “GTA 6 Online”, when it does arrive, there will be years of revenue waiting for Rockstar to cash in on.

articles.txt:
Dans GTA, la radio compte presque autant que les braquages : chaque épisode a ses stations, ses animateurs et ses fausses publicités, et GTA 6 en aligne 22 et deux en bonus, du jamais vu chez Rockstar. Un développeur identifié sous le pseudo Shrikar a réuni toutes ces radios sur GTAMusic.fun , un site gratuit qu’il a présenté sur X le 18 novembre , la veille de la sortie de GTA 6.
Le site compte 159 stations issues de douze jeux, et chacune tourne en enregistrement complet, avec ses animateurs, ses publicités et ses morceaux, sur fond d’écrans de chargement des jeux en question. On retrouve donc Lazlow sur V-Rock dans Vice City, DJ Cara sur Non-Stop Pop FM dans GTA V et les stars invitées de GTA 6, de Bad Bunny à Lana Del Rey en passant par Keith Richards.
Au lancement, GTA 6 n’avait droit qu’à des extraits, puisque le jeu n’était pas encore sorti. Ses 23 stations sont désormais au complet, y compris les deux radios parlées WKTT et The Wipe et The Vault Radio, qu’on débloque dans une boîte de nuit du jeu.
Je passe chez Apple ! Le Black Friday est lancé sur l’univers Apple. Sur Back Market, profitez de promotions sur les iPhone, MacBook, iPad, AirPods et Apple Watch. Chaque appareil est soumis à jusqu’à 100 points de contrôle qualité et est livré avec une garantie de 12 mois. De quoi profiter de performances comparables à celles d’un produit neuf.
Shrikar se présente comme un développeur qui travaille dans l’IA et le web3, et la nostalgie a beaucoup compté dans ce projet : il raconte avoir découvert GTA 3 et Vice City sur l’ordinateur portable de son cousin, à installer des mods et à taper des codes de triche.
Cette nostalgie se sent dans l’interface : on choisit un jeu, puis on maintient la touche Q du clavier (ou un appui long sur l’écran du téléphone) pour ouvrir la roue des radios, copiée sur celle de GTA V et GTA Online.
Tous les auditeurs entendent le même moment de chaque station, comme sur une radio FM. Impossible donc de revenir en arrière sur un morceau raté. Sur Android et iPhone, la lecture continue écran verrouillé : celui-ci affiche la station et le titre en cours, avec des boutons suivant et précédent qui servent à changer de station. Côté vie privée, le site dit ne collecter aucune donnée personnelle et se contente d’un comptage anonyme des visites par Cloudflare Web Analytics, sans cookie.
Le site le dit lui-même en bas de page : GTAMusic.fun est un projet non commercial, sans lien avec Rockstar Games ni avec sa maison mère Take-Two Interactive, et sans leur soutien.
Les enregistrements viennent de la chaîne YouTube GTA Radio Soundtracks et d’autres internautes, et une adresse e-mail permet aux ayants droit, éditeur comme maisons de disques, de demander un retrait, que le site promet rapide, le cas échéant.
Et la probabilité que ça arrive n’est pas nulle. Take-Two n’a pas la réputation d’être tendre avec les fans. En 2021, l’éditeur a fait retirer de GitHub re3 et reVC, des versions de GTA 3 et Vice City recréées par rétro-ingénierie, avant de poursuivre en justice leurs développeurs. On parle néanmoins ici de radios et non pas de jeux entiers, mais profitons-en tant qu’il est encore temps.

articles.chapeau: What to do at the plane crash random events in GTA 6.
articles.txt:
The Plane Crash is a possible random event in GTA 6 . This one is hard to miss, as you'll see a plane billowing black smoke in the sky before crashing into the distance. If you head to where it lands, then you can plunder the spoils - making for a quietly profitable money making exercise if you don't mind the diversion - or facing resistance some resistance when you arrive.
For more help with your time as Lucia and Jason in Leonida, take a look at our GTA 6 walkthrough .
Plane crashes are a type of event that can occur as you're exploring the world.
To date, we've seen two - one in Key Lento and another in Port Gellhorn - with the former at least appearing to be a fixed occurance as you make your way north to Hamlet for the Donnie's Packages mission in Chapter 1.
When you see a plane on fire in the sky, wait until it crashes - unfortunately for them, there's nothing you can do but watch - then head towards the crash site, which is indicated by the black smoke rising from the horizon .
The exact position won't be marked on the map, so you have to make your way there as best you can using the network of roads around you. With the smoke high in the sky, use that as your beacon to get closer and closer. Even though the crash site will ultimately be off the beaten path, there should be a road that gets you fairly close.
Once you've arrived, park up, make sure you're packing a weapon, and head to the crash site.
With the plane crashes we've encountered, you should uncover a number of cocaine stashes you can collect.
These will be littered amongst the wreckage far and wide, and make for a hefty payday if you can make it back to a fence to sell it all.
The difficulty, however, is you'll almost certainly encounter some resistance. This can take various forms:
Either way, carefully survey your surroundings both as you approach and when exploring the wreckage. If you are attacked, then try and position the plane fuselage between you and the aggressors, which will act as a shield while you equip or reload, or recover your Focus meter to respond in kind.
If you're encountering the plane crash event in Chapter 1, know you have a choice of who to sell the cocaine to - Donnie or Brian .

(Photo d’illustration) Tyrone Siu / REUTERS Passer la publicité Passer la publicité Publicité Les employés de Rockstar Games, l'éditeur de la saga GTA, ont rejeté la reconnaissance d'un syndicat interne , qui aurait été le plus important du secteur du jeu vidéo au Royaume-Uni selon l'Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB), ont annoncé le syndicat et le studio ce jeudi 26 novembre. Le scrutin de deux semaines portait sur un accord négocié depuis quatre mois entre la direction et les employés, visant à reconnaître le Rockstar Game Workers Union, branche de l'IWGB. Sur les plus de 1500 salariés de l'éditeur de Grand Theft Auto VI appelés à voter, plus de 75 % se sont exprimés contre.
La proposition rejetée jeudi aurait créé «un cadre formel» permettant aux employés du studio de négocier collectivement leurs conditions de travail avec la direction, notamment les salaires, la compensation des heures supplémentaires, les primes, les congés et les retraites, a détaillé le syndicat. Ce dernier pourra cependant continuer de se réunir et de recruter de nouveaux membres.
«Nous reconnaissons malheureusement que nous avons encore du travail à faire pour renforcer la compréhension et gagner la confiance d'un plus grand nombre de nos collègues» , a indiqué le Rockstar Game Workers Union dans un communiqué. «Ce résultat reflète le fort soutien de notre équipe en faveur de la poursuite des relations directes, de la collaboration et du dialogue ouvert» chez Rockstar, a pour sa part commenté la responsable de l'édition du studio, Jennifer Kolbe.
L'IWGB représente actuellement plusieurs anciens salariés devant le tribunal du travail de Glasgow, en Écosse, région berceau de la franchise. Il accuse Rockstar de les avoir licenciés en octobre 2025 en raison de leur activité syndicale. Le géant du jeu vidéo affirme que les plaignants avaient partagé des informations confidentielles, y compris sur le dernier volet de GTA, sur des canaux de discussion non sécurisés de la plateforme Discord.
Avec plus de 39 millions de joueurs uniques qui ont lancé le jeu sur PS5 en quelques jours après sa sortie il y a une semaine, le sixième opus de la saga GTA a marqué «le plus grand lancement de l'histoire de PlayStation» , d'après Sony.

articles.t: GTA 6 : un DJ set spécial de Justice débarque à Paris en décembre !
articles.chapeau: Avis aux gamers, votre prochaine mission vous attend ! Une soirée GTA 6 avec Justice arrive au Mia Mao à Paris le 3 décembre 2026. Ouverture de la billetterie dès ce jeudi 27 novembre 2026 !
articles.txt:
Et si votre prochaine mission se jouait sur une piste de danse ? Le 3 décembre 2026 , la soirée GTA 6 au Mia Mao, à Paris , donne rendez-vous aux amateurs de musique électronique avec Justice . Une rencontre entre l’univers de Grand Theft Auto VI et la nuit parisienne, pour laquelle il faudra d’abord cocher une autre date : le 27 novembre, jour d’ouverture de la billetterie . Premier objectif : décrocher son billet. Pour les figures de danse, chacun suivra ensuite son propre scénario.
Derrière Justice, on retrouve Gaspard Augé et Xavier de Rosnay , les deux complices du duo français. Leur signature ? Une électronique qui mélange l’énergie du rock et les pulsations du disco, avec un goût prononcé pour les sons musclés et les mélodies qui s’accrochent. Un cocktail qui donne rarement envie de rester sagement assis.
Le rapprochement avec GTA 6 ne sort d’ailleurs pas d’une mission secrète : Justice a composé la musique originale du jeu , dont la sortie en album est annoncée pour le 11 décembre 2026. Cette soirée parisienne s’inscrit donc dans une actualité où les frontières entre jeu vidéo et musique électronique se font particulièrement dansantes. Le programme musical précis du rendez-vous reste toutefois à découvrir.
Pour accueillir cette rencontre, direction La Villette. Mia Mao occupe une ancienne halle industrielle de 3 000 m² , transformée en club consacré aux musiques électroniques. De quoi changer sérieusement de décor après quelques heures passées devant son écran. Mia Mao Et justement, les écrans ne sont pas les vedettes du lieu : le club applique une politique sans photos ni vidéos . Ici, les souvenirs se fabriquent sur la piste plutôt que dans les stories. Une bonne occasion de quitter le mode spectateur.
Avant la soirée du 3 décembre , rendez-vous le 27 novembre pour l ’ouverture de la billetterie . Pas besoin de code de triche pour cette première étape : un rappel dans l’agenda fera très bien l’affaire.
L'abus d'alcool est dangereux pour la santé, à consommer avec modération.

GTA 6 sur PC : pourquoi cette fuite PS5 et Xbox inquiète pour votre carte graphique — Frandroid
articles.chapeau: Des fichiers issus de GTA 6 révèlent les réglages graphiques de la PS5 et des Xbox. En croisant la fuite avec les analyses de Digital Foundry, elle donne
articles.txt:
D’après le dataminer Tex2, qui a fouillé les fichiers du jeu, et le site MP1st qui a relayé sa liste ce mercredi 25 novembre, la PS5 et la Xbox Series X utiliseraient les mêmes réglages, surtout en « moyen » et « élevé ». La PS5 Pro ajoute des ombres calculées en ray tracing, ce que Rockstar a confirmé, tandis que la Xbox Series S baisserait la qualité des textures et réduirait même la foule dans les rues. Nous avons détaillé cette fuite ici . Rockstar n’a pas commenté le reste de la liste.
Pour un PC, la conséquence est simple : les cartes graphiques de notre guide de configuration visent ces réglages de console. Pour jouer avec une image plus belle que sur PS5, il faudra davantage de puissance.
Pour l’instant, GTA 6 n’existe que sur PS5 et Xbox Series, où il est sorti le 19 novembre. Rockstar n’a annoncé aucune version PC, mais GamesBeat affirme, sur la foi de quatre sources anonymes, qu’elle est prévue pour le premier trimestre 2027 ; le studio n’a pas commenté. Ce serait bien plus rapide que pour GTA 5 , arrivé sur PC en avril 2015, soit environ un an et sept mois après sa sortie sur PS3 et Xbox 360.
L’information la plus solide vient de Digital Foundry , qui a comparé le jeu sur les quatre consoles. Toutes utilisent le ray tracing, une technique qui simule le trajet de la lumière, pour l’éclairage et les reflets. Même la Xbox Series S, la moins puissante , le conserve, quitte à calculer son image en 720p et à passer souvent sous les 30 images par seconde.
Aucune console ne permet de couper le ray tracing. Cela ne dit pas encore ce que proposera la version PC.
C’est un problème pour les PC équipés d’une carte sans circuits dédiés au ray tracing : GeForce GTX (séries 900, 10 et 16), Radeon RX 500 et RX 5000. Elles représentent encore plus de 13 % des PC du sondage Steam d’octobre 2026 . Certaines GTX savent faire du ray tracing grâce à leur pilote, sans circuits dédiés, mais rien ne garantit qu’elles seraient acceptées par GTA 6, ni assez rapides.
Je passe chez Apple ! Le Black Friday est lancé sur l’univers Apple. Sur Back Market, profitez de promotions sur les iPhone, MacBook, iPad, AirPods et Apple Watch. Chaque appareil est soumis à jusqu’à 100 points de contrôle qualité et est livré avec une garantie de 12 mois. De quoi profiter de performances comparables à celles d’un produit neuf.
Trois scénarios sont possibles, sans qu’on sache lequel Rockstar choisira.
Des circuits de ray tracing obligatoires. Ces cartes seraient alors exclues. C’est le choix d’ Indiana Jones et le Cercle ancien et de Doom: The Dark Ages , qui exigent une carte équipée pour le ray tracing.
Un ray tracing logiciel. Comme dans Star Wars Outlaws ou Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora , le jeu calcule alors le ray tracing sans circuits dédiés, et se lance donc sur ces cartes. Dans les tests de TechPowerUp en 1080p, une Radeon RX 5700 XT y fait jeu égal avec une RX 6600, équipée pour le ray tracing, alors qu’elle la devance d’environ 10 % dans les jeux sans ray tracing.
Un mode PC sans ray tracing. Rockstar l’a fait pour GTA 5 Enhanced, la version modernisée de GTA 5 sur PC : le ray tracing y est facultatif, et une GeForce GTX 1630 suffit au minimum.
Si un tel mode existait, le gain pourrait être important. Dans un test de GTA 5 Enhanced réalisé par le site polonais PurePC , activer le ray tracing fait perdre de 41 à 57 % des images par seconde en 1080p sur ces cartes courantes :
Sur 36 jeux testés en 4K, TechSpot mesure une perte moyenne plus modérée : de 22 à 32 % sur une GeForce RTX 4090, de 29 à 42 % sur une Radeon RX 7900 XTX, selon le niveau de ray tracing.
Ces mesures restent à prendre avec précaution, car GTA 5 est un jeu de 2013 auquel le ray tracing a été ajouté après coup, et PurePC ne l’a testé que sur une seule scène. Elles ne disent pas ce que gagnerait GTA 6 .
Digital Foundry juge d’ailleurs l’éclairage en ray tracing de GTA 5 Enhanced relativement léger pour la carte graphique, mais lourd pour le processeur. Enfin, notre guide suppose le ray tracing activé, comme sur console : ces gains ne s’appliquent pas à ses recommandations.
Avec les calculs de notre dossier , voici ce que donneraient des réglages au plus bas sur trois cartes graphiques très répandues. Ces projections reposent sur des gains mesurés dans d’autres jeux, souvent sur des cartes haut de gamme : ce ne sont que des ordres de grandeur.
En « bas », avec le ray tracing. Dans Red Dead Redemption 2 , du même moteur, ces réglages rapportent environ 13 à 26 % d’images par seco

articles.t: Sans disque dans la boîte, GTA 6 réussit le plus gros lancement physique britannique depuis 2019 — Frandroid
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 a rapporté 32 millions de livres sterling, environ 38 millions d'euros, en trois jours dans les boutiques britanniques. Aucun jeu n'avait fait un aussi bon démarrage physique au Royaume-Uni depuis FIFA 20 en septembre 2019, et la boîte de GTA 6 ne contient pourtant aucun disque, seulement un code de téléchargement.
articles.txt:
Avec GTA 6 , Rockstar a fait un choix qui pouvait inquiéter les magasins : la boîte vendue en rayon ne contient qu’un code de téléchargement, sans aucun disque. Ça n’a pas freiné les acheteurs.
D’après les relevés du cabinet Nielsen IQ, publiés ce jeudi 26 novembre par la newsletter spécialisée The Game Business , GTA 6 a fait au Royaume-Uni le plus gros lancement physique depuis 2019. Sorti le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series, le jeu accumulait déjà les records , jusqu’à devenir le plus gros lancement de l’histoire PlayStation .
En trois jours, le jeu a généré 32 millions de livres de revenus outre-Manche. Pour trouver un jeu qui s’était autant vendu en boîte pendant sa première semaine au Royaume-Uni, il faut remonter à FIFA 20, en septembre 2019, avant le Covid.
Dans l’historique des classements britanniques, qui remonte à 1995, GTA 6 arrive au 17e rang des plus gros lancements physiques. Le démarrage serait encore plus fort en France, où plus d’un million de boîtes auraient été vendues en trois jours, selon les informations de The Game Business, soit un volume proche de celui de GTA 5 en 2013. En Espagne, GTA 6 a même signé le plus gros lancement physique de l’histoire du classement national.
GTA 6 ne tourne pas sur PS4. Autrement dit, ceux qui jouaient encore sur l’ancienne génération ont dû changer de console . Au Royaume-Uni, les ventes de PS5 ont bondi de 46 % la semaine du lancement, et celles des Xbox Series S et X ont progressé de 75 %, leur plus forte hausse depuis 2024. Toutes marques confondues, les ventes de consoles ont augmenté de 38 % sur la semaine, après une hausse de 29 % la semaine précédente.
Aux États-Unis, le cabinet d’études Circana a vu l’effet arriver avant même la sortie du jeu. Pendant la semaine qui s’est terminée le 14 novembre, les ventes de PS5 ont été multipliées par 2,4 par rapport à la semaine d’avant, et celles des Xbox Series par 2,3.
Les smartphones aussi ont profité de l’engouement, puisque les anciens GTA ont vu leurs téléchargements sur mobile grimper la même semaine .
Ces classements ne comptent en effet que les boîtes. Or, le 20 novembre, Take-Two, la maison mère de Rockstar, a estimé que GTA 6 avait généré 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes dans le monde dès son premier jour (environ 3,5 milliards d’euros).
L’éditeur n’a pas indiqué combien de ces ventes venaient des boîtes et combien d’achats en numérique.

articles.t: GTA 6 Encrypted Hard Drive: What Is on It?
articles.chapeau: What is on the encrypted hard drive in GTA 6? A senator, partial footage and a lot of unconfirmed claims. Here is what reports back up.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games Spoiler warning: this article discusses a story item and a scene from Grand Theft Auto VI . If you want to find it yourself, stop here.
The encrypted hard drive is a story item in Grand Theft Auto VI , and players have spent days trying to work out what it holds. Beebom’s spoiler piece, which asked what is on the drive and claimed to answer it, became the top gaming story of the week. The honest answer is narrower than the headline suggests. The game decrypts part of the drive and shows footage of a woman referred to as “Senator.” It never shows the whole thing.
That gap between what the game shows and what the internet claims is the real story. Since GTA 6 reached PS5 and Xbox , players have pulled every thread in Leonida, and the encrypted drive is one of the loudest. This analysis separates what reports confirm from what they only suggest, explains why Rockstar might have built the scene this way, and lays out what to watch next.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the basics. The encrypted hard drive is a story item inside the game, and reports place it in a bag alongside a statue. That is the full extent of what the fact record says about where it sits. Nothing in the coverage I reviewed gives a mission name, a map location or a sequence number, so this article does not invent one.
Why does a bag with a statue matter? Because it frames the drive as something a character wanted hidden or moved. A drive tucked in with a statue reads as cargo, not as a keepsake. That framing is analysis, not confirmed lore, and it should stay labeled that way. What reports do confirm is the pairing itself and the fact that the drive is encrypted.
Encryption is the key design signal here. A locked drive promises a payoff, and the game follows through by decrypting some of it. Players then see the result on screen, which is why the story spread so fast. The reveal is visual, short on explanation and heavy on implication.
The game shows decrypted video footage involving a woman referred to as “Senator.” Reports agree the footage includes the senator using drugs. That is the confirmed visual content, and it is the only content the reporting supports. Everything else attached to this scene needs a caveat.
The second confirmed point matters just as much. The footage is only a partial decryption. The game does not reveal the full contents of the drive, and reports say so directly. A player who watches the scene and walks away believing they have seen everything has misread it.
Think of it as a trailer for a document. The decrypted slice proves the drive holds compromising material and tells you who the material concerns. It does not tell you why the drive exists, who made it, or who wants it. Those gaps are where the speculation lives.
Several reports identify Camila Fuentes as the senator in the footage. That identification is itself confirmed as a pattern of reporting. Whether Fuentes is truly the woman on screen is a different question, and it stays unconfirmed. The coverage is inconsistent, and no official Rockstar source backs the match.
This distinction trips up a lot of readers. “Several outlets say X” and “X is true” are separate claims. When outlets copy each other, repetition looks like corroboration even though it is one source echoed five times. Treat the Fuentes name as a strong lead from players and writers, not as a character sheet from Rockstar.
The cautious reading holds up well. The game calls the woman “Senator,” which is a title, not a name. A name attached to that title in reporting could come from other scenes, dialogue or in-game documents that outlets stitched together. Without the underlying source, nobody can verify the link from the outside.
The unconfirmed list is longer than the confirmed one, and that is by design. Below is the clean split, built only from the fact record.
One report says the drive contains footage of Fuentes calling an unknown man “daddy” or “papi.” No other verified source repeats it. Treat it as a rumor until someone shows the scene with timestamps, or until Rockstar confirms it. It may be accurate. The point is that nobody has demonstrated it.

articles.chapeau: En quelques jours, des fans ont lancé une version pirate de GTA 6 sur PC à partir d’une fuite Xbox, alors que seul le jeu console est sorti. Ce coup de force inédit ouvre un bras de fer explosif avec Rockstar, dont l’issue reste très incertaine.
articles.txt:
En quelques jours, des fans ont lancé une version pirate de GTA 6 sur PC à partir d’une fuite Xbox, alors que seul le jeu console est sorti. Ce coup de force inédit ouvre un bras de fer explosif avec Rockstar, dont l’issue reste très incertaine.
Grand Theft Auto VI est officiellement sorti le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S , sans aucune date PC confirmée. Pourtant, quelques jours ont suffi pour que des développeurs passionnés fassent démarrer une version pirate de GTA 6 sur Windows à partir d’une build Xbox de 209 Go, complétée par un exécutable de 57 Mo publié par le groupe Cyberleek , comme le rappellent Les Numériques. Du jamais vu à cette vitesse.
Autour de projets comme Leonida , VIctory ou XCL , la communauté s’est fixé un objectif résumé par GameStar : avoir « GTA 6 pour PC avant GTA 6 pour PC ». Serveurs Discord géants, centaines de forks sur GitHub, outils d’IA pour aider au portage, tout s’est emballé en quelques heures. Reste à savoir si ce tour de force doit vraiment inquiéter Rockstar Games ou si l’éditeur peut, pour l’instant, dormir tranquille.
La base de tout, c’est la fuite de la version Xbox de GTA 6 , incluant les données complètes et l’exécutable. Les projets non officiels utilisent soit une recompilation statique, comme Leonida, qui traduit le binaire Xbox en binaire Windows, soit une couche de compatibilité comme XCL qui simule l’environnement de la console. Des outils d’IA servent à analyser le code et générer des portions compatibles PC plus vite qu’à la main.
Résultat concret : XCL affiche déjà les menus de GTA 6 à environ 30 images par seconde, en avalant près de 15 Go de RAM. VIctory va plus loin en chargeant le monde ouvert en une cinquantaine de secondes, mais la scène reste quasi noire et tourne à quelques fps seulement. Certains forks rapportent 22 fps pendant une quarantaine de minutes avant un crash de la carte graphique.
Leonida, lui, affirmait avoir converti tous les shaders et promettait une version jouable en « au moins une semaine » avant de disparaître. Malgré cette avancée, on est encore loin d’un jeu réellement praticable : pas de stabilité, pas de GTA Online , accès réservé à une poignée d’utilisateurs capables de manipuler une fuite illégale de plus de 200 Go.
Pour les joueurs PC, ces démonstrations prouvent surtout que GTA 6 tourne déjà, d’une façon ou d’une autre, sur leur plateforme alors que Take Two Interactive n’a toujours pas annoncé de version Windows. Comme pour GTA V et Red Dead Redemption 2 , la stratégie semble rester console d’abord, PC plus tard, des sources de l’industrie évoquant seulement un créneau autour du premier trimestre 2027.
En parallèle, les médias français alertent sur la prolifération de faux « GTA 6 PC » truffés de malwares. Télécharger une version piratée expose à des chevaux de Troie, mais aussi à des risques juridiques bien réels : en France, la contrefaçon d’une œuvre protégée peut entraîner jusqu’à 3 ans de prison et 300 000 € d’amende, même si l’ARCOM est moins visible qu’à l’époque de la Hadopi.
Pour jouer légalement sur un PC aujourd’hui, la seule voie reste le streaming depuis une console via Remote Play ou équivalent Xbox, avec un exemplaire acheté de manière classique. Tout le reste, qu’il s’agisse de builds compilées à partir de la fuite ou de faux installateurs, reste à éviter.
La réaction de Take Two a été immédiate. Le 24 novembre 2026, une plainte DMCA a conduit GitHub à retirer Leonida et 3 007 dépôts associés. Le serveur Discord du projet, qui avait atteint environ 179 000 membres, a été fermé, tout comme le compte du développeur principal, âgé de 15 ans, selon Frandroid. GameStar parle d’un « jeu du chat et de la souris » à une échelle inédite.
Sur le plan commercial, l’impact semble pourtant limité à court terme. Les versions actuelles sont instables, techniquement hors de portée du grand public et totalement privées de composante en ligne. Les quelques milliers de curieux capables de les lancer sont, pour la plupart, le cœur de cible qui achètera aussi la version officielle console ou PC.
Le vrai risque pour Rockstar se situe plutôt du côté de l’image et du contrôle de son jeu phare. Voir circuler des séquences illisibles à 5 fps sous l’étiquette « GTA 6 PC » brouille le message et met en lumière une faille de sécurité majeure. articles.t: GTA 6 : une fuite détaille les écarts graphiques entre PS5, PS5 Pro et Xbox
articles.chapeau: Une fuite des réglages graphiques de GTA 6 détaille plein de petits détails techniques sur les versions du jeu comme les ombres en ray tracing de la PS5 Pro. Sur Xbox Series S, les compromis iraient même jusqu’à réduire le trafic et le nombre de piétons dans Vice City.
articles.txt:
Une fuite des réglages graphiques de GTA 6 détaille plein de petits détails techniques sur les versions du jeu comme les ombres en ray tracing de la PS5 Pro. Sur Xbox Series S, les compromis iraient même jusqu’à réduire le trafic et le nombre de piétons dans Vice City.
Si toutes les versions de GTA 6 tournent à 30 images par seconde, la qualité des graphismes varie d'une console à l'autre. ©RichieSanders x Shutterstock Les différences entre les versions console de GTA 6 se verraient jusque dans les embouteillages de Vice City. Rockstar vise 30 images par seconde sur les quatre machines, et un relevé de réglages que le dataminer Tex2 dit avoir tiré des fichiers du jeu donne un aperçu des compromis faits pour tenir cette cadence.
Partagé le 25 novembre sur X par Tex2, le document a depuis disparu du réseau social. Heureusement, certains sites comme MP1st, ont pu reproduire les tableaux des réglages graphiques de GTA 6 , console par console.
Dans ces tableaux, la PS5 standard et la Xbox Series X partagent les mêmes réglages graphiques. Les textures et la tessellation, qui subdivise les surfaces pour affiner leur géométrie, y sont réglées sur « élevé ». L’illumination globale, le calcul des rebonds de la lumière entre les surfaces, reste sur « moyen ». Rockstar avait déjà précisé que les deux consoles calculent leur image en 1440p avant de la reconstruire en 4K avec le même algorithme maison d’anticrénelage temporel, ou TAA.
La PS5 Pro conserve les textures en qualité élevée et part elle aussi du 1440p. Elle s’appuie sur le PSSR 2 de Sony pour reconstruire l’image en 4K. Rockstar avait déjà confirmé qu’elle serait la seule à calculer des ombres en ray tracing .
D’après le relevé, l’illumination globale passerait sur « élevé ». Le lancer de rayons servirait à calculer l’ombre d’un arbre au soleil aussi bien que celle d’un passant sous un lampadaire. Les réglages correspondants, pour les ombres directionnelles et les ombres liées aux sources de lumière locales, seraient tous deux sur « élevé ». Leurs équivalents calculés par rastérisation passeraient sur « faible ».
Sur Series S, Rockstar part d’une image en 720p que le FSR 4 d’AMD reconstruit en 1080p. Les développeurs disent avoir tenu à conserver l’illumination globale en ray tracing malgré la mémoire plus limitée de la console. D’après les tableaux, la qualité des textures et celle de la simulation de l’eau et des vagues reculeraient à « moyen ». La tessellation, elle, tomberait sur « faible ».
L’écart se verrait aussi dans la rue. Sur Series S, la densité des piétons et celle du trafic seraient toutes deux réglées sur « moyen », contre « élevé » sur les trois autres consoles. Le même écart apparaît dans les réglages de la physique et dans plusieurs paramètres de l’IA. Comme quoi, même à Vice City, le diable se cache dans les détails.
GTA VI 79,99 € Foire aux questions Contenu généré par l’IA Quelle est la différence entre la rastérisation et le ray tracing pour calculer les ombres dans un jeu ? La rastérisation calcule l’image en projetant des triangles sur l’écran, puis en appliquant des astuces (shadow maps, filtrage, biais) pour simuler les ombres à moindre coût. Le ray tracing, lui, lance des rayons dans la scène pour déterminer si un point est éclairé ou occulté, ce qui produit des ombres généralement plus cohérentes (contacts plus crédibles, pénombres mieux gérées). En pratique, le ray tracing est nettement plus gourmand en calcul et en bande passante mémoire, d’où des choix ciblés (activer certaines ombres RT et baisser d’autres réglages). Beaucoup de jeux combinent les deux : RT pour quelques effets « premium », rastérisation pour le reste afin de tenir une cadence stable.
L’upscaling reconstruit une image de sortie (1080p/4K) à partir d’un rendu interne plus bas (720p/1440p) pour réduire la charge GPU tout en gardant une image détaillée. Le TAA (Temporal Anti-Aliasing) exploite plusieurs images successives et les vecteurs de mouvement pour lisser les bords et stabiliser le rendu, mais il peut introduire du flou ou des artefacts sur les fins détails. PSSR 2 (Sony) et FSR 4 (AMD) sont des techniques de reconstruction qui utilisent elles aussi des informations temporelles et spatiales, avec des approches et une qualité variables selon le contenu affiché. Le principe reste le même : économiser du calcul en rendu natif, puis « remonter » la définition pour viser une sortie 4K ou 1080p plus propre.
